  <script>
    // Stats Counter Animation
    const statNumbers = document.querySelectorAll('.stat-number');
    let statsAnimated = false;

    function animateCounter(el) {
      const target = parseInt(el.dataset.target);
      const duration = 2000;
      const start = performance.now();
      const easeOut = t => 1 - Math.pow(1 - t, 3);

      function update(now) {
        const elapsed = now - start;
        const progress = Math.min(elapsed / duration, 1);
        const eased = easeOut(progress);
        const current = Math.floor(eased * target);
        el.textContent = current.toLocaleString();
        if (progress < 1) requestAnimationFrame(update);
      }
      requestAnimationFrame(update);
    }

    const statsObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting && !statsAnimated) {
          statsAnimated = true;
          statNumbers.forEach((el, i) => {
            setTimeout(() => animateCounter(el), i * 150);
          });
        }
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.5 });

    document.querySelector('.stats') && statsObserver.observe(document.querySelector('.stats'));

    // Tab Switching
    document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(tab => {
      tab.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.tab').forEach(t => t.classList.remove('active'));
        tab.classList.add('active');
        // Update grid content based on tab
        const tabName = tab.dataset.tab;
        const grid = document.getElementById('screenshot-grid');
        const labels = {
          'screens': ['Profile', 'Wallet', 'Welcome', 'Account Setup', 'Home', 'Subscription', 'Login', 'Settings'],
          'ui-elements': ['Buttons', 'Inputs', 'Cards', 'Lists', 'Navbars', 'Modals', 'Avatars', 'Badges'],
          'flows': ['Onboarding', 'Checkout', 'Sign Up', 'Settings', 'Search', 'Profile Edit', 'Payment', 'Share'],
          'text': ['Welcome back', 'Get started', 'Sign in', 'Create account', 'Subscribe', 'Upgrade', 'Continue', 'Done']
        };
        const items = labels[tabName] || labels['screens'];
        grid.innerHTML = items.map(label => `
          <div class="screenshot-card"><div class="screenshot-placeholder">${label}</div></div>
        `).join('');
      });
    });

    // Filter Pills
    document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(pill => {
      pill.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.pill').forEach(p => p.classList.remove('active'));
        pill.classList.add('active');
        // Visual feedback on grid
        const grid = document.getElementById('screenshot-grid');
        grid.style.opacity = '0.5';
        setTimeout(() => grid.style.opacity = '1', 200);
      });
    });

    // Flow Toggle
    document.querySelectorAll('.flow-toggle-btn').forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        document.querySelectorAll('.flow-toggle-btn').forEach(b => b.classList.remove('active'));
        btn.classList.add('active');
        const flow = btn.dataset.flow;
        document.querySelectorAll('.flow-content').forEach(c => c.classList.remove('active'));
        document.querySelector(`[data-flow-content="${flow}"]`).classList.add('active');
      });
    });

    // Fade-in on scroll
    const fadeEls = document.querySelectorAll('.section-header, .tools-grid, .stat-item');
    fadeEls.forEach(el => el.classList.add('fade-in'));
    const fadeObserver = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
      entries.forEach(entry => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) entry.target.classList.add('visible');
      });
    }, { threshold: 0.15 });
    fadeEls.forEach(el => fadeObserver.observe(el));
  </script>

steps.message:
The ScreenVault landing page has been built and output to `/app/output/index.html`. Here's a summary of what was created:

### Page Structure
- **Announcement Bar** — "2025 ScreenVault Awards" banner
- **Sticky Header** — Logo + Pricing, Awards, Log in navigation with blur backdrop
- **Hero** — "Discover real-world design inspiration" headline with dual CTAs
- **Trusted By** — Logo row of Figma, Notion, Shopify, Spotify, Airbnb, Stripe
- **Stats Section** — Animated counters (1,150 apps / 615,900 screens / 329,200 flows) triggered on scroll with ease-out easing and staggered start
- **Search Features** — Tab switching (Screens, UI Elements, Flows, Text in Screenshot) + 10 filter pills that update the screenshot grid dynamically
- **Flows Section** — Toggle between Videos and Prototype mode with phone mockups and animated hotspots
- **Tools Section** — 3 feature cards (Copy to Figma, Save to collections, Leave comments)
- **Testimonials** — 2-row auto-scrolling marquee with all 6 testimonials, alternating directions
- **CTA Section** — "Never run out of inspiration again" with dual CTAs + brand marquee (16 brands, 2 rows, alternating directions)
- **Footer** — Tagline, explore/contact/social columns, copyright

### Interactions Implemented
| Interaction | Implementation |
|---|---|
| Stats counter | IntersectionObserver-triggered, ease-out cubic, staggered 150ms |
| Search tabs | Click switches active tab + updates grid content |
| Filter pills | Click activates pill + visual grid refresh |
| Flows toggle | Switches between Videos and Prototype mode views |
| Testimonials | CSS `@keyframes` marquee, 2 rows, opposite directions, pause on hover |
| Brand marquee | Same marquee technique with 16 brand names |
| Fade-in sections | IntersectionObserver reveals sections on scroll |

### Design Choices
- **Typography**: Inter (geometric sans-serif) with tight letter-spacing
- **Palette**: #141414 primary, white background, #F5F5F5 surfaces, #6366F1 electric violet accent
- **Responsive**: Adapts from 4-column grids → 2-column → 1-column; mobile nav collapses to CTA-only
- **No build step**: Single HTML file, opens directly in browser
